description: This file defines the PdfString class in the PDFsharp library, which handles PDF string objects, including encoding, decoding, and serialization logic. It also includes an enum for string encodings and internal flags.

classes.name: PdfString
classes.description: Represents a direct text string value used within a PDF document, supporting various encodings and providing methods for encoding, decoding, and string manipulation.

classes.name: PdfStringEncoding
classes.description: Enumeration of different character encodings for PdfString objects, such as Raw, Standard, PDF Document, WinAnsi, MacRoman, MacExpert, and Unicode.

methods.name: PdfString(string value)
methods.description: Constructs a PdfString with the specified string value. Automatically determines if Unicode encoding is needed.

methods.name: PdfString(string value, PdfStringEncoding encoding)
methods.description: Constructs a PdfString with a specified value and encoding.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Gets the length of the string in characters.

methods.name: Encoding
methods.description: Gets the encoding type of the string.

methods.name: HexLiteral
methods.description: Indicates whether the string is stored as a hexadecimal literal.

methods.name: GetRawBytes()
methods.description: Converts the string value to its raw byte representation.

methods.name: SetRawBytes(byte[] value, PdfStringEncoding? encoding = null)
methods.description: Sets the string value from raw bytes, optionally updating encoding flags.

methods.name: TryRereadAsUnicode()
methods.description: Rereads and interprets the string as Unicode if applicable.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation suitable for serialization or debugging.

methods.name: ToStringFromPdfDocEncoded()
methods.description: Converts document-encoded string to a readable string, replacing code points with their encoded representation.
